units.zh: 漢興，接秦之獘，丈夫從軍旅，老弱轉糧馕，作業劇而財匱，自天子不能具鈞駟，而將相或乘牛車，齊民無藏蓋。
units.en: When Han rose, it inherited Qin’s exhaustion. Men followed military campaigns, and the old and infirm transported grain and food. Labor was heavy and wealth scarce; even the Son of Heaven could not equip matched horses, while generals and ministers sometimes rode ox carts and commoners had nothing in reserve.
units.literal: Han rose, connected Qin exhaustion, men followed military campaigns, old weak transported grain food, work intense and wealth scarce, from Son of Heaven could not equip matched horses, and generals ministers or rode ox carts, common people no stored covers.

units.zh: 於是為秦錢重難用，更令民鑄錢，一黃金一斤，約法省禁。
units.en: Therefore, because Qin coinage was heavy and hard to use, they further ordered the people to cast money, fixing the value at one catty of gold per jin, and regulated the laws while reducing prohibitions.
units.literal: Therefore, because Qin coinage was heavy and hard to use, they further ordered the people to cast money, with one catty of gold to one jin, and regulated the laws while reducing prohibitions.

units.zh: 而不軌逐利之民，蓄積餘業以稽市物，物踴騰糶，米至石萬錢，馬一匹則百金。
units.en: People who broke the rules to pursue profit hoarded surplus goods to control the market, driving prices up. Rice reached ten thousand cash per shi, and a single horse cost a hundred gold.
units.literal: And lawless profit-seeking people accumulated surplus stock to control market goods; goods leaped in price, rice reached ten thousand cash per shi, and one horse then cost a hundred gold.

units.zh: 天下已平，高祖乃令賈人不得衣絲乘車，重租稅以困辱之。
units.en: After the realm was pacified, Emperor Gaozu then ordered that merchants could not wear silk or ride carriages and imposed heavy taxes to disgrace them.
units.literal: World already pacified, Gao Zu then ordered merchants not wear silk ride carriages, heavy taxes to distress humiliate them.

units.zh: 孝惠、高后時，為天下初定，復弛商賈之律，然市井之子孫亦不得仕宦為吏。
units.en: During the time of Emperor Xiaohui and Empress Dowager Gao, since the realm had only just been settled, they again relaxed the laws on merchants, yet the sons and grandsons of the marketplace still could not serve as officials or clerks.
units.literal: Xiao Hui, Gao Hou time, because world initially settled, again relaxed merchant laws, yet marketplace sons grandsons also not allowed serve as officials be clerks.

units.zh: 量吏祿，度官用，以賦於民。
units.en: They measured clerk salaries and estimated official expenses, then levied them on the people.
units.literal: Measured clerk salaries, estimated official expenses, to levy on people.

units.zh: 而山川園池市井租稅之入，自天子以至于封君湯沐邑，皆各為私奉養焉，不領於天下之經費。
units.en: Revenues from mountains, rivers, parks, ponds, and marketplaces, from the Son of Heaven down to the enfeoffed lords and their maintenance estates, were all reserved for private support and not counted among the realm's ordinary expenses.
units.literal: And mountains rivers parks ponds marketplace tax incomes, from Son of Heaven down to sealed lords hot bath towns, all each for private support, not included in world regular expenses.

units.zh: 漕轉山東粟，以給中都官，歲不過數十萬石。
units.en: Grain from Shandong was transported to supply the central offices, and the yearly total did not exceed several hundred thousand shi.
units.literal: Shandong grain was transported by canal to supply the central government offices, no more than several hundred thousand shi per year.

units.zh: 至孝文時，莢錢益多，輕，乃更鑄四銖錢，其文為「半兩」，令民縱得自鑄錢。
units.en: By the time of Emperor Xiaowen, elm-seed tokens had grown numerous and light, so they cast new four-zhu coins bearing the inscription “half liang,” and allowed the people to cast coins freely.
units.literal: To Xiaowen’s time, elm-seed tokens grew many and light; then they recast four-zhu money, its inscription “half liang,” and ordered the people freely to cast money.

units.zh: 故吳諸侯也，以即山鑄錢，富埒天子，其後卒以叛逆。
units.en: Therefore, the feudal lord of Wu cast coins near the mountains, became as rich as the Son of Heaven, and later finally rebelled.
units.literal: Therefore, Wu feudal lord, by near mountain cast money, rich equal Son of Heaven, his after finally with rebellion.

units.zh: 鄧通，大夫也，以鑄錢財過王者。
units.en: Deng Tong, a grand master, grew richer than kings by casting money.
units.literal: Deng Tong, grand master, with casting money wealth exceeded kings.

units.zh: 故吳、鄧氏錢布天下，而鑄錢之禁生焉。
units.en: Thus, the coinage of Wu and the Deng clan spread throughout the realm, and the prohibition on casting money arose from it.
units.literal: Therefore, Wu, Deng clan money spread world, and casting money prohibition born there.

units.zh: 匈奴數侵盜北邊，屯戍者多，邊粟不足給食當食者。
units.en: The Xiongnu frequently invaded and robbed the northern border, and those who garrisoned and defended were many, so border grain was insufficient to supply food to those who should eat.
units.literal: Xiongnu frequently invaded robbed north border, garrisoned defended many, border grain insufficient supply food should eat ones.

units.zh: 於是募民能輸及轉粟於邊者拜爵，爵得至大庶長。
units.en: They therefore recruited people able to transport grain to the frontier and rewarded them with noble ranks, up to Grand Chief.
units.literal: Therefore, they recruited people who could transport grain to the border and granted nobility ranks up to the rank of Grand Chief.

units.zh: 孝景時，上郡以西旱，亦復修賣爵令，而賤其價以招民；
units.en: During the time of Emperor Xiaojing, when there was a drought west of Shangjun, the order allowing the sale of noble ranks was revived and the prices were lowered to attract buyers;
units.literal: Xiao Jing time, Shang Jun west drought, also again repaired sell nobility rank command, and cheapened its price to attract people;

units.zh: 及徒復作，得輸粟縣官以除罪。
units.en: Convicts sentenced to renewed labor could also deliver grain to the government in order to have their crimes expunged.
units.literal: And convict labor again worked, got transport grain county officials to remove crime.

units.zh: 益造苑馬以廣用，而宮室列觀輿馬益增修矣。
units.en: They further increased the palace-park horses for wider use, and palaces, towers, carriages, and horses were expanded and refurbished.
units.literal: Moreover, made garden horses to broaden use, and palace rooms arranged towers carriages horses moreover increased repaired.

units.zh: 至今上即位數歲，漢興七十餘年之閒，國家無事，非遇水旱之災，民則人給家足，都鄙廩庾皆滿，而府庫餘貨財。
units.en: By the time the present emperor had been on the throne for several years, in the more than seventy years since Han rose, the nation had no affairs. When they did not encounter water or drought disasters, the people then had each person supplied and each house sufficient, the granaries of cities and towns were all full, and the treasuries had surplus goods and wealth.
units.literal: To now emperor ascended throne several years, Han rise seventy more years between, nation no affairs, not encounter water drought disasters, people then person supplied house sufficient, cities towns granaries all full, and treasuries surplus goods wealth.

units.zh: 京師之錢累巨萬，貫朽而不可校。
units.en: The money in the capital accumulated in enormous quantities, until the strings rotted, and the coins could no longer be counted.
units.literal: Capital money accumulated huge ten thousand, strings rotted and could not be counted.

units.zh: 太倉之粟陳陳相因，充溢露積於外，至腐敗不可食。
units.en: The grain in the great granary, old grain following old grain, was full and overflowed, exposed and piled outside, until it rotted and could not be eaten.
units.literal: Great granary grain old old mutually followed, full overflowed exposed piled outside, to rotten could not be eaten.

units.zh: 眾庶街巷有馬，阡陌之閒成群，而乘字牝者儐而不得聚會。
units.en: Commoners in streets and alleys had horses, and along the paths and crossroads they formed groups; those who rode government-branded mares were shunned and could not gather for meetings.
units.literal: The masses in streets and alleys had horses, and between paths and crossroads they formed groups; those who rode government-branded mares were shunned and could not gather for meetings.

units.zh: 守閭閻者食粱肉，為吏者長子孫，居官者以為姓號。
units.en: Those who guarded the alley gates ate fine grain and meat, those who served as clerks extended their sons and grandsons, and those who resided as officials took it as their surname and appellation.
units.literal: Guarded alley gates ate fine grain meat, served as clerks extended sons grandsons, resided as officials took as surname appellation.

units.zh: 故人人自愛而重犯法，先行義而後絀恥辱焉。
units.en: Therefore, each person loved themselves and valued not violating the law, first practiced righteousness, and then shrank from shame and humiliation.
units.literal: Therefore, each person self loved and valued not violate law, first practiced righteousness then shrank from shame humiliation.

units.zh: 當此之時，網疏而民富，役財驕溢，或至兼并豪黨之徒，以武斷於鄉曲。
units.en: At this time, the net of law was loose, and the people were wealthy. Some became arrogant and extravagant in their use of wealth, even annexing land and gathering powerful retainers, using force to dominate local affairs.
units.literal: At this time, the legal net was loose and the people were wealthy. Some grew arrogant and extravagant in their use of wealth, even annexing land and gathering powerful followers, and settled affairs in the countryside by force.

units.zh: 宗室有土公卿大夫以下，爭于奢侈，室廬輿服僭于上，無限度。
units.en: The imperial clan, territorial lords, high ministers, and officials below them competed in extravagance, and their houses, carriages, and clothing exceeded the privileges allowed by their rank.
units.literal: The imperial clan, territorial lords, high ministers, and officials below them competed in extravagance, and their houses, carriages, and clothing overstepped the privileges of their superiors without limit.

units.zh: 物盛而衰，固其變也。
units.en: When things flourish, they then decline; this is certainly their change.
units.literal: Things flourish then decline, certainly their change.

units.zh: 自是之後，嚴助、朱買臣等招來東甌，事兩越，江淮之閒蕭然煩費矣。
units.en: After this, Yan Zhu, Zhu Maichen, and others brought in Dong'ou, dealt with the two Yue, and between the Jiang and Huai the region was drained and expenses mounted.
units.literal: After this, Yan Zhu, Zhu Maichen, and others summoned Dong'ou, dealt with the two Yue, and between the Jiang and Huai the region was drained and expenses mounted.

units.zh: 唐蒙、司馬相如開路西南夷，鑿山通道千餘里，以廣巴蜀，巴蜀之民罷焉。
units.en: Tang Meng and Sima Xiangru opened roads to the southwest barbarians, chiseled mountains and opened paths for more than a thousand li, to broaden Bashu, and the people of Bashu were exhausted by this.
units.literal: Tang Meng, Sima Xiang Ru opened road southwest barbarians, chiseled mountain opened path thousand more li, to broaden Ba Shu, Ba Shu people exhausted there.

units.zh: 彭吳賈滅朝鮮，置滄海之郡，則燕齊之閒靡然發動。
units.en: Peng Wujia destroyed Joseon and established Canghai Commandery, after which the region between Yan and Qi was heavily mobilized for resources.
units.literal: Peng Wujia destroyed Joseon and established Canghai Commandery, and then between Yan and Qi resources were massively mobilized.

units.zh: 及王恢設謀馬邑，匈奴絕和親，侵擾北邊，兵連而不解，天下苦其勞，而干戈日滋。
units.en: When Wang Hui laid his stratagem at Mayi, the Xiongnu broke off the heqin alliance and invaded and harassed the northern frontier. Warfare continued without end, and the realm suffered under the strain.
units.literal: When Wang Hui set his stratagem at Mayi, the Xiongnu broke off the heqin alliance, invaded and harassed the northern border, wars continued without end, the realm suffered from the labor, and arms daily increased.

units.zh: 行者齎，居者送，中外騷擾而相奉，百姓抏獘以巧法，財賂衰秏而不贍。
units.en: Travelers carried provisions, residents supplied them, and the inner and outer regions were thrown into mutual disturbance. The common people were worn down by shrewd regulations, their wealth dwindled, their bribes ran short, and still these were not enough.
units.literal: Travelers carried provisions, residents sent, inside outside disturbed mutually supplied, hundred surnames constrained exhausted with skillful laws, wealth bribes declined expended not sufficient.

units.zh: 入物者補官，出貨者除罪，選舉陵遲，廉恥相冒，武力進用，法嚴令具。
units.en: Those who brought in goods got offices, and those who exported goods were pardoned. Appointments declined, integrity and shame were trampled underfoot, military power advanced, and the laws were harsh while the commands were complete.
units.literal: Entered goods ones filled offices, exported goods ones removed crime, selections declined, integrity shame mutually deceived, martial force advanced used, laws strict commands complete.

units.zh: 興利之臣自此始也。
units.en: The ministers who promoted profit began from this point.
units.literal: Arouse benefit ministers from this began also.

units.zh: 其後漢將歲以數萬騎出擊胡，及車騎將軍衛青取匈奴河南地，筑朔方。
units.en: Afterward Han generals each year led tens of thousands of cavalry to attack the Hu, and the General of Chariots and Cavalry, Wei Qing, took the Xiongnu lands south of the Yellow River and built Shuofang.
units.literal: Its after Han generals yearly with several ten thousand cavalry went out attacked Hu, and chariot cavalry general Wei Qing took Xiongnu Yellow River south land, built Shuo Fang.

units.zh: 當是時，漢通西南夷道，作者數萬人，千里負擔饋糧，率十餘鐘致一石，散幣於邛僰以集之。
units.en: At that time Han opened roads to the southwestern barbarians, employing tens of thousands of workers. For a thousand li, they carried loads and fed grain, at a rate of more than ten zhong to deliver one shi, and scattered coins at Qiong and Bo to gather laborers.
units.literal: When this time, Han opened southwest barbarians road, workers several ten thousand, thousand li carried loads fed grain, rate ten more zhong delivered one shi, scattered coins at Qiong Bo to gather it.

units.zh: 數歲道不通，蠻夷因以數攻，吏發兵誅之。
units.en: After several years the road was still unfinished. The Man and Yi took advantage of this to launch repeated attacks, and officials mobilized troops against them.
units.literal: For several years the road remained incomplete, and the Man and Yi repeatedly attacked; officials mobilized troops to punish them.

units.zh: 悉巴蜀租賦不足以更之，乃募豪民田南夷，入粟縣官，而內受錢於都內。
units.en: Even all the taxes of Bashu were insufficient for the task, so wealthy men were recruited to farm among the southern tribes; they turned in grain to the county officials and received cash in the capital.
units.literal: All Ba Shu rents taxes insufficient to change it, then recruited rich people farmed south barbarians, entered grain county officials, and internally received money at capital inside.

units.zh: 東至滄海之郡，人徒之費擬於南夷。
units.en: To the east, as far as Canghai Commandery, the expenses in manpower and transport were comparable to those among the southern tribes.
units.literal: In the east, the expedition to Canghai Commandery cost as much in manpower as the campaigns against the Southern Yi.

units.zh: 又興十萬餘人筑衛朔方，轉漕甚遼遠，自山東咸被其勞，費數十百巨萬，府庫益虛。
units.en: They again raised more than a hundred thousand people to build Shuofang and defend it. Transport was extremely distant, and all of Shandong suffered the labor; the cost ran into many millions, and the treasuries grew emptier.
units.literal: Again raised ten thousand more people built defended Shuo Fang, transported very far distant, from Shan Dong all suffered its labor, cost several ten hundred huge ten thousand, treasuries moreover empty.

units.zh: 乃募民能入奴婢得以終身復，為郎增秩，及入羊為郎，始於此。
units.en: Then they recruited men who could contribute slaves and women in exchange for lifetime exemption, promoted them to lang, and also made those who contributed sheep into lang. This began at this time.
units.literal: Then recruited people could enter slave women got lifetime exemption, became lang increased rank, and entered sheep became lang, began from this.

units.zh: 其後四年，而漢遣大將將六將軍，軍十餘萬，擊右賢王，獲首虜萬五千級。
units.en: Four years later, the Han sent a great general with six generals and an army of more than a hundred thousand to attack the Right Worthy King, and took fifteen thousand heads and captives.
units.literal: Its after four years, and Han sent great general led six generals, army ten more thousand, attacked right worthy king, obtained heads captives ten five thousand ranks.

units.zh: 明年，大將軍將六將軍仍再出擊胡，得首虜萬九千級。
units.en: The next year, the great general again led the six generals out against the Hu and took nineteen thousand heads and captives.
units.literal: Next year, great general led six generals still again went out attacked Hu, got heads captives ten nine thousand ranks.

units.zh: 捕斬首虜之士受賜黃金二十餘萬斤，虜數萬人皆得厚賞，衣食仰給縣官；
units.en: The soldiers who captured and beheaded the enemy received more than two hundred thousand jin of yellow gold, and the captives, numbering tens of thousands, all received generous rewards; their clothing and food were supplied by the county officials.
units.literal: Captured beheaded heads captives soldiers received rewarded yellow gold twenty more ten thousand jin, captives several ten thousand people all got thick reward, clothing food looked up supplied county officials;

units.zh: 而漢軍之士馬死者十餘萬，兵甲之財轉漕之費不與焉。
units.en: The dead soldiers and horses of the Han army numbered more than a hundred thousand, and the cost of armor and transport is not included.
units.literal: And Han army soldiers horses dead ones ten more thousand, weapons armor wealth transported expenses not included there.

units.zh: 於是大農陳藏錢經秏，賦稅既竭，猶不足以奉戰士。
units.en: By then, the Grand Farmer's cash reserves had been depleted and tax revenues exhausted, yet there was still not enough to support the soldiers.
units.literal: By then, the Grand Farmer's cash reserves had been depleted and tax revenues exhausted, yet there was still not enough to support the soldiers.

units.zh: 有司言：「天子曰『朕聞五帝之教不相復而治，禹湯之法不同道而王，所由殊路，而建德一也。
units.en: The officials said: “The Son of Heaven has said, ‘I have heard that the teachings of the Five Emperors were not repeated, yet they governed; the laws of Yu and Tang were different, yet they both became kings. What they came from was different, but the virtue they established was the same.
units.literal: Officials spoke: 'Son of Heaven said 'I heard five emperors teachings not repeated and governed, Yu Tang laws different ways and kinged, what from different roads, but established virtue one also.

units.zh: 北邊未安，朕甚悼之。
units.en: The northern frontier is not at peace, and I am deeply troubled by it.
units.literal: North border not peaceful, I very mourn it.

units.zh: 日者，大將軍攻匈奴，斬首虜萬九千級，留蹛無所食。
units.en: Recently, the great general attacked the Xiongnu, taking nineteen thousand heads and captives, but the detained prisoners were left with nothing to eat.
units.literal: Recently the great general attacked the Xiongnu, beheaded nineteen thousand heads and captives, and left the detained captives with nothing to eat.

units.zh: 議令民得買爵及贖禁錮免減罪』。
units.en: We ask that people be allowed to buy ranks and redeem penalties and confinement, and thereby reduce crimes.'
units.literal: Discuss ordered people could buy nobility rank and redeem prohibitions imprisonments exempt reduce crimes.'

units.zh: 請置賞官，命曰武功爵。
units.en: We request the establishment of reward offices, to be called martial merit ranks.
units.literal: Request establish reward officials, named martial merit nobility ranks.

units.zh: 級十七萬，凡直三十餘萬金。
units.en: There were 170,000 ranks in all, worth more than 300,000 in gold.
units.literal: There were 170,000 ranks in all, worth more than 300,000 in gold.

units.zh: 諸買武功爵官首者試補吏，先除；
units.en: Those who buy the martial merit rank first are tested for office and given priority in exemption;
units.literal: Various buy martial merit nobility rank officials first ones tested filled clerks, first exempted;

units.zh: 千夫如五大夫；
units.en: a thousand-man commander is treated like a fifth-grade grand master;
units.literal: Thousand leader like five grand masters;

units.zh: 其有罪又減二等；
units.en: if they have committed crimes, their sentence is reduced by two grades;
units.literal: Their had crimes moreover reduced two grades;

units.zh: 爵得至樂卿：以顯軍功。」
units.en: and the rank can rise as high as Leqing, all to display military merit.”
units.literal: Nobility rank could reach music minister: to display military merit.'

units.zh: 軍功多用越等，大者封侯卿大夫，小者郎吏。
units.en: Military merit often leapt past the ordinary ranks: the greatest were enfeoffed as marquises, ministers, and grandees, while lesser men became palace gentlemen and clerks.
units.literal: Military merit often bypassed the usual ranks, with the greatest being enfeoffed as marquises, ministers, and grandees, and the lesser as palace gentlemen and clerks.

units.zh: 吏道雜而多端，則官職秏廢。
units.en: When the paths of official advancement become mixed and too many, the offices are worn down and ruined.
units.literal: Clerk ways mixed and many branches, then official duties expended abolished.

units.zh: 自公孫弘以春秋之義繩臣下取漢相，張湯用唆文決理為廷尉，於是見知之法生，而廢格沮誹窮治之獄用矣。
units.en: After Gongsun Hong used the principles of the Spring and Autumn Annals to discipline his subordinates and attain the Han chancellorship, and Zhang Tang used severe legal arguments to decide cases and become Commandant of Justice, the law punishing officials who saw and knew of crimes without reporting them arose, and prosecutions for neglect, obstruction, disparagement, and slander were pursued exhaustively.
units.literal: After Gongsun Hong used the principles of the Spring and Autumn Annals to discipline his subordinates and attain the Han chancellorship, and Zhang Tang used severe legal arguments to decide cases and become Commandant of Justice, the law punishing officials who saw and knew of crimes without reporting them arose, and prosecutions for neglect, obstruction, disparagement, and slander were pursued exhaustively.

units.zh: 其明年，淮南、衡山、江都王謀反跡見，而公卿尋端治之，竟其黨與，而坐死者數萬人，長吏益慘急而法令明察。
units.en: The next year, the traces of the Huainan, Hengshan, and Jiangdu kings’ rebellion were discovered, and the dukes and ministers pursued the case to its root and destroyed their followers. Those who were condemned and died numbered in the tens of thousands, and the senior clerks became even harsher and more exacting, with the laws and commands more and more strictly enforced.
units.literal: Its next year, Huai Nan, Heng Shan, Jiang Du kings plotted rebellion traces seen, and dukes ministers sought beginnings governed them, exhausted their parties allies, and sat died ones several ten thousand people, senior clerks moreover cruel urgent and laws commands clear examined.

units.zh: 當是之時，招尊方正賢良文學之士，或至公卿大夫。
units.en: At that time they recruited and honored upright, worthy, and learned men, some of whom reached the rank of duke, minister, or grand master.
units.literal: When this time, recruited honored upright worthy good literature scholars, or reached dukes ministers grand masters.

units.zh: 公孫弘以漢相，布被，食不重味，為天下先。
units.en: Gongsun Hong, as Han chancellor, used a cloth coverlet and ate plain food, and was regarded as a model for the realm.
units.literal: Gongsun Hong became Han chancellor, cloth coverlet, ate not repeated flavors, was world first.

units.zh: 然無益於俗，稍騖於功利矣。
units.en: Yet this did not help customs, and they gradually drifted toward profit and advantage.
units.literal: Yet no benefit to customs, gradually raced to merit profit.

units.zh: 其明年，驃騎仍再出擊胡，獲首四萬。
units.en: The next year, the swift cavalry again went out to attack the Hu and took forty thousand heads.
units.literal: Its next year, super cavalry still again went out attacked Hu, obtained heads forty thousand.

units.zh: 其秋，渾邪王率數萬之眾來降，於是漢發車二萬乘迎之。
units.en: That autumn, the Hunye King led tens of thousands to surrender, and Han accordingly sent twenty thousand carriages to welcome them.
units.literal: Its autumn, Hun Ye king led several ten thousand crowd came surrendered, therefore Han sent carriages twenty thousand teams welcomed them.

units.zh: 既至，受賞，賜及有功之士。
units.en: Once they arrived, rewards were bestowed, and the meritorious soldiers received their share.
units.literal: Having arrived, received rewards, bestowed reached meritorious warriors.

units.zh: 是歲費凡百餘巨萬。
units.en: That year’s expenses altogether amounted to more than a hundred huge ten-thousands.
units.literal: This year expenses altogether hundred more huge ten thousand.

units.zh: 初，先是往十餘歲河決觀，梁楚之地固已數困，而緣河之郡隄塞河，輒決壞，費不可勝計。
units.en: Earlier, for more than ten years before this, the Yellow River had burst at Guan, and the lands of Liang and Chu had already suffered repeatedly. The commanderies along the river built dikes to block it, but each time the river burst and the defenses failed, and the cost was beyond counting.
units.literal: Initially, before this ten more years Yellow River burst Guan, Liang Chu lands certainly already repeatedly distressed, and along Yellow River commanderies dikes blocked river, then burst broke, expenses could not be completely counted.

units.zh: 其後番系欲省底柱之漕，穿汾、河渠以為溉田，作者數萬人；
units.en: Afterward, Fan Xi wanted to reduce transport at Dizhu, so he dug a canal from the Fen and the Yellow River to irrigate fields, employing tens of thousands of workers;
units.literal: Its after Fan Xi wanted reduce Di Zhu transport, dug Fen, Yellow River canal to irrigate fields, workers several ten thousand;

units.zh: 鄭當時為渭漕渠回遠，鑿直渠自長安至華陰，作者數萬人；
units.en: because the Wei transport canal was circuitous and far, Zheng Dangshi cut a straight canal from Chang’an to Huayin, employing tens of thousands of workers;
units.literal: Because the Wei transport canal made a long detour, Zheng Dangshi dug a direct canal from Chang'an to Huayin, employing tens of thousands of workers;

units.zh: 朔方亦穿渠，作者數萬人：各歷二三期，功未就，費亦各巨萬十數。
units.en: Shuofang also dug a canal, employing tens of thousands of workers. Each project dragged on for two or three periods, but it was never completed, and the expense in each case ran to many millions.
units.literal: Shuo Fang also dug canal, workers several ten thousand: each experienced two three periods, merit not completed, expenses also each huge ten thousand several.

units.zh: 天子為伐胡，盛養馬，馬之來食長安者數萬匹，卒牽掌者關中不足，乃調旁近郡。
units.en: For the campaign against the Hu, the Son of Heaven greatly raised horses. Tens of thousands of horses came to feed at Chang’an, but Guanzhong did not have enough men to tend them, so they requisitioned from nearby commanderies.
units.literal: Son of Heaven for attacked Hu, greatly raised horses, horses that came ate Chang An several ten thousand horses, soldiers led cared ones Guan Zhong insufficient, then transferred nearby commanderies.

units.zh: 而胡降者皆衣食縣官，縣官不給，天子乃損膳，解乘輿駟，出御府禁藏以贍之。
units.en: All the surrendered Hu had to be fed and clothed by the government, but the government could not meet the demand. The Son of Heaven therefore reduced his own meals, released horses from the imperial carriage teams, and drew on the palace storehouses to support them.
units.literal: And Hu surrendered ones all clothed fed county officials, county officials not supplied, Son of Heaven then reduced meals, released carriage teams, took out imperial storehouse forbidden stores to support them.

units.zh: 其明年，山東被水菑，民多饑乏，於是天子遣使者虛郡國倉廥以振貧民。
units.en: The next year, Shandong suffered flooding and many people were hungry and destitute. The Son of Heaven therefore sent messengers to empty the commanderies’ and kingdoms’ granaries to relieve the poor.
units.literal: Its next year, Shan Dong suffered water disaster, people many hungry lacking, therefore Son of Heaven sent messengers emptied commandery kingdom granaries to relieve poor people.

units.zh: 猶不足，又募豪富人相貸假。
units.en: Even so it was still not enough, so they recruited wealthy men to lend to the poor.
units.literal: Still it was insufficient; moreover they recruited wealthy men to lend to the poor.

units.zh: 尚不能相救，乃徙貧民於關以西，及充朔方以南新秦中，七十餘萬口，衣食皆仰給縣官。
units.en: Still this was not enough to save them all, so the poor were moved west of the pass and into the newly settled Qin region south of Shuofang, more than seven hundred thousand people in all, with food and clothing supplied by the government.
units.literal: Still could not mutually save, then moved poor people to pass west, and filled Shuo Fang south new Qin middle, seventy more ten thousand mouths, clothing food all looked up supplied county officials.

units.zh: 數歲，假予產業，使者分部護之，冠蓋相望。
units.en: For several years they were given land and property, and the messengers were assigned in districts to protect them, with official canopies and banners appearing everywhere.
units.literal: Several years, lent gave properties, messengers divided sections protected them, official hats canopies mutually gazed.

units.zh: 其費以億計，不可勝數。
units.en: The expense was counted in hundreds of millions and could not be measured.
units.literal: Its expenses counted in hundred million, could not be completely counted.

units.zh: 於是縣官大空。
units.en: Thus, the county offices were left greatly depleted.
units.literal: Therefore, county officials greatly empty.

units.zh: 而富商大賈或蹛財役貧，轉轂百數，廢居居邑，封君皆低首仰給。
units.en: Rich merchants and great traders either hoarded wealth and employed the poor, rotated wagon hubs by the hundreds, hoarded goods and waited in towns, and the enfeoffed lords all bowed their heads and relied on them for supplies.
units.literal: The rich merchants and great traders either hoarded wealth and employed the poor, rotated axles by the hundreds, hoarded goods and resided in towns, and the enfeoffed lords all lowered their heads and looked up to them for supply.

units.zh: 冶鑄煮鹽，財或累萬金，而不佐國家之急，黎民重困。
units.en: Through smelting, casting, and boiling salt, wealth accumulated to tens of thousands of gold, but it did not help the state’s urgent needs, and the common people were heavily burdened.
units.literal: Smelted cast boiled salt, wealth or accumulated ten thousand gold, but not assisted nation urgent, common people heavily distressed.

units.zh: 於是天子與公卿議，更錢造幣以贍用，而摧浮淫并兼之徒。
units.en: Therefore, the Son of Heaven discussed the matter with the dukes and ministers, remade the currency to supply public use, and checked the men who grew fat on floating gains and monopoly.
units.literal: Therefore, Son of Heaven with dukes ministers discussed, changed money made currency to support use, and crushed floating lewd annexed merged followers.

units.zh: 是時禁苑有白鹿而少府多銀錫。
units.en: At this time the forbidden park had white deer and the Shaofu had abundant silver and tin.
units.literal: This time forbidden park had white deer and Shao Fu much silver tin.

units.zh: 自孝文更造四銖錢，至是歲四十餘年，從建元以來，用少，縣官往往即多銅山而鑄錢，民亦閒盜鑄錢，不可勝數。
units.en: From the time Emperor Xiaowen cast the four-zhu coin, more than forty years had passed by this year. Since Jianyuan, coinage was scarce, and the county officials often took the copper from many mountains to cast money; the people also secretly cast coins in great numbers.
units.literal: From Xiao Wen moreover made four zhu money, to this year forty more years, from Jian Yuan since, use few, county officials often took many copper mountains and cast money, people also secretly stole cast money, could not be completely counted.

units.zh: 錢益多而輕，物益少而貴。
units.en: Money became more numerous and lighter, while goods became scarcer and dearer.
units.literal: Money moreover many and light, goods moreover few and expensive.

units.zh: 有司言曰：「古者皮幣，諸侯以聘享。
units.en: The officials said: “In ancient times there was leather currency, which the feudal lords used for presenting gifts and making offerings.
units.literal: Officials spoke: 'Ancient ones leather currency, feudal lords with presented enjoyed.

units.zh: 金有三等，黃金為上，白金為中，赤金為下。
units.en: Gold had three grades: yellow gold as the highest, white gold as the middle, and red gold as the lowest.
units.literal: Gold had three grades, yellow gold as upper, white gold as middle, red gold as lower.

units.zh: 今半兩錢法重四銖，而姦或盜摩錢裏取鋊，錢益輕薄而物貴，則遠方用幣煩費不省。」
units.en: Now the half-liang coin weighs four zhu, but corrupt men grind the inside of the coins and take out filings, so money becomes thinner and lighter while goods grow dearer; thus currency used in distant places becomes troublesome and costly.”
units.literal: Now half liang money method heavy four zhu, but evil ones or stole ground money inside took filings, money moreover light thin and goods expensive, then distant places used currency troublesome costly not economical.'

units.zh: 乃以白鹿皮方尺，緣以藻繢，為皮幣，直四十萬。
units.en: Then they took a square foot of white deer skin, edged it with embroidered ornament, and made leather currency worth four hundred thousand.
units.literal: Then with a square foot of white deer skin, edged with embroidered ornament, they made leather currency worth four hundred thousand.

units.zh: 王侯宗室朝覲聘享，必以皮幣薦璧，然後得行。
units.en: When kings, marquises, and the imperial clan had audiences or made offerings, they had to present jade bi with leather currency and only then could proceed.
units.literal: Kings marquises imperial clan morning audiences presented enjoyed, must with leather currency presented jade bi, then could proceed.

units.zh: 又造銀錫為白金。
units.en: They also made silver and tin into white gold.
units.literal: Moreover, made silver tin as white gold.

units.zh: 以為天用莫如龍，地用莫如馬，人用莫如龜，故白金三品：其一曰重八兩，圜之，其文龍，名曰「白選」，直三千；
units.en: They held that for heaven nothing was better than the dragon, for earth nothing better than the horse, and for man nothing better than the turtle. Therefore, there were three grades of white gold: the first weighed eight liang, was round, bore a dragon, and was called “White Selection,” worth three thousand;
units.literal: Considered heaven use nothing like dragon, earth use nothing like horse, person use nothing like turtle, therefore white gold three kinds: its one said heavy eight liang, rounded it, its inscription dragon, named 'white select', worth three thousand;

units.zh: 二曰以重差小，方之，其文馬，直五百；
units.en: the second had a slightly lighter weight, was square, bore a horse, and was worth five hundred;
units.literal: Two said with weight difference small, squared it, its inscription horse, worth five hundred;

units.zh: 三曰復小，撱之，其文龜，直三百。
units.en: the third was smaller still, was made oval, bore a turtle, and was worth three hundred;
units.literal: The third was smaller still, made oval, bore a turtle, and was worth three hundred.

units.zh: 令縣官銷半兩錢，更鑄三銖錢，文如其重。
units.en: They ordered the county officials to melt down the half-liang coins and cast new three-zhu coins with inscriptions matching their weight.
units.literal: Ordered county officials melted half liang money, moreover cast three zhu money, inscription like its weight.

units.zh: 盜鑄諸金錢罪皆死，而吏民之盜鑄白金者不可勝數。
units.en: Those who privately cast gold coins were all liable to death, yet the clerks and commoners who secretly cast white gold coins were too many to count.
units.literal: Stole cast various gold money crimes all death, but clerks people stole cast white gold ones could not be completely counted.

units.zh: 於是以東郭咸陽、孔僅為大農丞，領鹽鐵事；
units.en: Therefore, they made Dongguo Xianyang and Kong Jin the Great Farmer Assistant, to lead salt and iron affairs;
units.literal: Therefore, with Dongguo Xian Yang, Kong Jin as Great Farmer Assistant, led salt iron affairs;

units.zh: 桑弘羊以計算用事，侍中。
units.en: Sang Hongyang handled financial calculations as a Palace Attendant.
units.literal: Sang Hong Yang with calculations handled affairs, Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 咸陽，齊之大煮鹽，孔僅，南陽大冶，皆致生累千金，故鄭當時進言之。
units.en: Xianyang was a major salt producer from Qi, and Kong Jin was a major iron smelter from Nanyang. Both had amassed fortunes of thousands of gold, and therefore Zheng Dangshi recommended them.
units.literal: Xianyang was a major salt producer from Qi, and Kong Jin a major iron smelter from Nanyang; both had amassed fortunes of several thousand in gold, so Zheng Dangshi recommended them.

units.zh: 弘羊，雒陽賈人子，以心計，年十三侍中。
units.en: Hongyang was the son of a merchant from Luoyang. Because of his skill at mental calculation, he became a Palace Attendant at the age of thirteen.
units.literal: Hong Yang, Luo Yang merchant son, with mental calculations, year thirteen Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 故三人言利事析秋豪矣。
units.en: Thus, when these three men discussed matters of profit, they analyzed them down to the finest detail.
units.literal: Therefore, three people spoke profit affairs analyzed autumn down.

units.zh: 法既益嚴，吏多廢免。
units.en: The laws grew increasingly severe, and many officials were dismissed from office.
units.literal: The laws grew increasingly severe, and many officials were dismissed from office.

units.zh: 兵革數動，民多買復及五大夫，徵發之士益鮮。
units.en: Military campaigns were frequent, and many people bought exemptions or the rank of Wudafu, so the pool of men available for conscription kept shrinking.
units.literal: Military campaigns were frequent, and many people bought exemptions or the rank of Wudafu, so the number of men available for conscription grew increasingly small.

units.zh: 於是除千夫五大夫為吏，不欲者出馬；
units.en: Men holding the Qianfu and Wudafu ranks were then appointed as clerks; those who did not wish to serve supplied horses instead.
units.literal: Thereupon men of the Qianfu and Wudafu ranks were appointed as clerks; those who did not wish to serve provided horses instead.

units.zh: 故吏皆（通）適令伐棘上林，作昆明池。
units.en: Therefore, all former officials were ordered to clear brambles at Shanglin and build Kunming Pool.
units.literal: Therefore, old clerks all universally ordered cut thorns Shang Lin, made Kunming Pool.

units.zh: 其明年，大將軍、驃騎大出擊胡，得首虜八九萬級，賞賜五十萬金，漢軍馬死者十餘萬匹，轉漕車甲之費不與焉。
units.en: The next year, the great general and swift cavalry greatly went out to attack the Hu, obtained eighty or ninety thousand ranks of heads and captives, and rewarded and bestowed five hundred thousand gold. The dead horses of the Han army numbered more than a hundred thousand, and the expenses for transport, ferrying, chariots, and armor were not included in this.
units.literal: Its next year, great general, super cavalry greatly went out attacked Hu, got heads captives eighty nine thousand ranks, rewarded bestowed fifty ten thousand gold, Han army horses dead ones ten more ten thousand horses, transported ferried chariots armor expenses not included there.

units.zh: 是時財匱，戰士頗不得祿矣。
units.en: At this time, funds were scarce, and many soldiers did not receive their pay.
units.literal: This time wealth scarce, warriors rather not got salary.

units.zh: 有司言三銖錢輕，易姦詐，乃更請諸郡國鑄五銖錢，周郭其下，令不可磨取鋊焉。
units.en: The officials said that three-zhu coins were too light and easily counterfeited, so they further requested that the commanderies and kingdoms cast five-zhu coins with a raised rim, making it impossible to grind off filings.
units.literal: Officials spoke three zhu money light, easy evil deception, then moreover requested various commanderies kingdoms cast five zhu money, surrounded protected its bottom, ordered could not grind take filings there.

units.zh: 大農上鹽鐵丞孔僅、咸陽言：「山海，天地之藏也，皆宜屬少府，陛下不私，以屬大農佐賦。
units.en: The Great Farmer submitted a proposal from the salt and iron assistants Kong Jin and Xianyang: 'The mountains and seas are the storehouses of heaven and earth, and should all belong to the Privy Treasurer. Your Majesty does not keep them for private use, but assigns them to the Great Farmer to support public revenues.
units.literal: Great Farmer submitted salt iron assistant Kong Jin, Xian Yang spoke: 'Mountains seas, heaven earth stores also, all should belong Shao Fu, Your Majesty not private, to belong Great Farmer assist taxes.

units.zh: 願募民自給費，因官器作煮鹽，官與牢盆。
units.en: We ask to recruit people who will cover their own expenses and use official equipment to boil salt, with the government providing the iron pans.
units.literal: Wish recruit people self supply expenses, using official tools make boil salt, officials give iron pans.

units.zh: 浮食奇民欲擅管山海之貨，以致富羨，役利細民。
units.en: Idlers and speculators wish to monopolize the products of the mountains and seas, enrich themselves, and exploit the common people for profit.
units.literal: Floating eating strange people wish monopolize control mountains seas goods, to become rich abundant, employ profit small people.

units.zh: 其沮事之議，不可勝聽。
units.en: Their obstructionist arguments are too many to listen to.
units.literal: Their obstructed affairs discussions, could not be completely heard.

units.zh: 敢私鑄鐵器煮鹽者，釱左趾，沒入其器物。
units.en: Anyone who dares privately to cast iron tools or boil salt shall have the left toe fettered and all tools and goods confiscated.
units.literal: Dare privately cast iron tools boil salt ones, branded left toe, confiscated their tools goods.

units.zh: 郡不出鐵者，置小鐵官，便屬在所縣。」
units.en: In commanderies that do not produce iron, establish minor iron offices and attach them to the local counties.'
units.literal: Commanderies not produce iron ones, establish small iron officials, conveniently belong local counties.'

units.zh: 使孔僅、東郭咸陽乘傳舉行天下鹽鐵，作官府，除故鹽鐵家富者為吏。
units.en: They sent Kong Jin and Dongguo Xianyang by relay carriage to inspect salt and iron operations throughout the empire, establish government offices, and appoint wealthy men from the former salt and iron families as officials.
units.literal: Made Kong Jin, Dongguo Xian Yang ride post carriages toured world salt iron, established official offices, removed former salt iron family rich ones served as clerks.

units.zh: 吏道益雜，不選，而多賈人矣。
units.en: The ranks of officials became increasingly mixed and were no longer carefully selected; many were merchants.
units.literal: Clerk ways moreover mixed, not selected, and many merchants.

units.zh: 商賈以幣之變，多積貨逐利。
units.en: The merchants, because of the currency changes, accumulated many goods and pursued profit.
units.literal: Merchants with currency changes, many accumulated goods pursued profit.

units.zh: 於是公卿言：「郡國頗被菑害，貧民無產業者，募徙廣饒之地。
units.en: Therefore, the dukes and ministers said: 'The commanderies and kingdoms have rather suffered disasters, and the poor people who have no property should be recruited and moved to broad and fertile lands.
units.literal: Therefore, dukes ministers spoke: 'Commanderies kingdoms rather suffered disasters, poor people no property ones, recruit move broad fertile lands.

units.zh: 陛下損膳省用，出禁錢以振元元，寬貸賦，而民不齊出於南畝，商賈滋眾。
units.en: Your Majesty reduced meals and economized use, took out forbidden money to relieve the common people, and leniently lent taxes, but the people did not uniformly go out to the south fields, and merchants increased greatly.
units.literal: Your Majesty reduced meals economized use, took out forbidden money to relieve common people, leniently lent taxes, but people not uniformly went out to south fields, merchants increased many.

units.zh: 貧者畜積無有，皆仰縣官。
units.en: The poor had no reserves, and all depended on the county officials.
units.literal: Poor ones stored accumulated none had, all looked up county officials.

units.zh: 異時算軺車賈人緡錢皆有差，請算如故。
units.en: At earlier times, taxes on light carriages, merchants, and registered cash holdings were all graded. We request that they be taxed as before.
units.literal: Different times taxed light carriages merchants string money all had differences, request tax as before.

units.zh: 諸賈人末作貰貸賣買，居邑稽諸物，及商以取利者，雖無市籍，各以其物自占，率緡錢二千而一算。
units.en: Merchants engaged in secondary occupations, borrowing and lending, buying and selling, living in towns, hoarding goods, and taking profit from trade, even if they had no market registration, were each to register themselves and their goods. The rate was one tax for every two thousand strings of cash.
units.literal: Various merchants end business borrowed lent bought sold, resided towns delayed various goods, and merchants to take profit ones, although no market registration, each with their goods self registered, rate string money two thousand and one tax.

units.zh: 諸作有租及鑄，率緡錢四千一算。
units.en: For rented enterprises and casting operations, the rate was one assessment for every four thousand strings of cash.
units.literal: Various works had rent and cast, rate string money four thousand one tax.

units.zh: 非吏比者三老、北邊騎士，軺車以一算；
units.en: For those not of clerk rank, the three elders and north border cavalry, light carriages were taxed at one tax;
units.literal: Not clerk rank ones three elders, north border cavalry, light carriages with one tax;

units.zh: 商賈人軺車二算；
units.en: merchant people's light carriages were taxed at two taxes;
units.literal: Merchant people light carriages two taxes;

units.zh: 船五丈以上一算。
units.en: boats of five zhang or above were taxed at one tax.
units.literal: Boats five zhang above one tax.

units.zh: 匿不自占，占不悉，戍邊一歲，沒入緡錢。
units.en: Those who concealed their holdings and did not register, or registered incompletely, were sent to garrison the frontier for one year, and their cash holdings were confiscated.
units.literal: Concealed not self registered, registered not complete, garrisoned border one year, confiscated string money.

units.zh: 有能告者，以其半畀之。
units.en: Those who were able to report were given half of it.
units.literal: Had could report ones, with their half gave them.

units.zh: 賈人有市籍者，及其家屬，皆無得籍名田，以便農。
units.en: Merchants registered in the market rolls, and their dependents, could not register titled land, to favor farming.
units.literal: Merchants had market registration ones, and their family dependents, all not got registered named fields, to facilitate farming.

units.zh: 敢犯令，沒入田僮。」
units.en: Those who dare to violate the command will have their fields and servants confiscated.'
units.literal: Dare violate command, confiscated fields servants.'

units.zh: 天子乃思卜式之言，召拜式為中郎，爵左庶長，賜田十頃，布告天下，使明知之。
units.en: The Son of Heaven then recalled Bu Shi's words, summoned and appointed Shi as Palace Attendant, granted him the rank of Left Chief of the Multitude, granted ten qing of fields, and proclaimed it to the realm, so all would know.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven then recalled Bu Shi's words, summoned and appointed Shi as Palace Attendant, granted him the rank of Left Chief of the Multitude, granted ten qing of fields, and proclaimed it to the realm so all would know.

units.zh: 初，卜式者，河南人也，以田畜為事。
units.en: Initially, Bu Shi was a person from Henan, and he took farming and livestock as his affairs.
units.literal: Initially, Bu Shi was, He Nan person also, with farming livestock as affairs.

units.zh: 親死，式有少弟，弟壯，式脫身出分，獨取畜羊百餘，田宅財物盡予弟。
units.en: When his parents died, Shi had a young brother. When the brother grew up, Shi separated himself and divided the property, taking alone more than a hundred livestock sheep, and giving all the fields, houses, wealth, and goods to his brother.
units.literal: Parents died, Shi had young brother, brother grew up, Shi separated body out divided, alone took livestock sheep hundred more, fields houses wealth goods all gave brother.

units.zh: 式入山牧十餘歲，羊致千餘頭，買田宅。
units.en: Shi entered the mountains and pastured for more than ten years, and the sheep brought more than a thousand heads, so he bought fields and houses.
units.literal: Shi entered mountain pastured ten more years, sheep brought thousand more heads, bought fields houses.

units.zh: 而其弟盡破其業，式輒復分予弟者數矣。
units.en: Whenever his brother squandered his property, Bu Shi again divided off part of his own property and gave it to him.
units.literal: When his brother squandered his property, Bu Shi repeatedly divided off shares of his own property and gave them to him.

units.zh: 是時漢方數使將擊匈奴，卜式上書，願輸家之半縣官助邊。
units.en: At this time, Han was just frequently sending generals to attack the Xiongnu, and Bu Shi submitted a memorial, wishing to transport half of his family's wealth to the county officials to assist the border.
units.literal: This time Han just frequently sent generals attacked Xiongnu, Bu Shi memorialed, wished transport family half county officials assist border.

units.zh: 天子使使問式：「欲官乎？」
units.en: The Son of Heaven sent a messenger to ask Shi, “Do you want an official post?”
units.literal: The Son of Heaven sent a messenger to ask Shi: “Do you wish for office?”

units.zh: 式曰：「臣少牧，不習仕宦，不願也。」
units.en: Shi said, “Your servant has herded animals since youth and does not understand official service. I do not want it.”
units.literal: Shi said: “Your servant has herded since youth and is not versed in official service; I do not wish it.”

units.zh: 使問曰：「家豈有冤，欲言事乎？」
units.en: The messenger asked, “Does your household perhaps have some grievance you wish to report?”
units.literal: The messenger asked: “Does your household perhaps have a grievance you wish to report?”

units.zh: 式曰：「臣生與人無分爭。
units.en: Shi said, “Your servant has lived his life without quarreling with others.
units.literal: Shi said: “Your servant has gone through life without quarreling with others.

units.zh: 式邑人貧者貸之，不善者教順之，所居人皆從式，式何故見冤於人！
units.en: I lend to the poor in my village and teach and guide the unruly. Everyone where I live follows me, so why would I suffer grievance from others?
units.literal: I lend to the poor among my townspeople and teach and guide those who are unruly; those where I live all follow me—why should I suffer grievance from others!

units.zh: 無所欲言也。」
units.en: There is nothing I wish to say.”
units.literal: There is nothing I wish to say.”

units.zh: 使者曰：「茍如此，子何欲而然？」
units.en: The messenger said, “If that is so, sir, what do you want, and why are you acting this way?”
units.literal: The messenger said: “If it is so, sir, what do you want, and why act thus?”

units.zh: 式曰：「天子誅匈奴，愚以為賢者宜死節於邊，有財者宜輸委，如此而匈奴可滅也。」
units.en: Shi said, “The Son of Heaven is punishing the Xiongnu. Your foolish servant thinks that the worthy should die loyally at the frontier and the wealthy should contribute their goods. In this way the Xiongnu can be destroyed.”
units.literal: Shi said: “The Son of Heaven is punishing the Xiongnu. I, your foolish servant, think the worthy should die loyally at the border and the wealthy should contribute their goods; in this way the Xiongnu can be destroyed.”

units.zh: 使者具其言入以聞。
units.en: The messenger completed his words and entered to report.
units.literal: Messenger complete his words entered to report.

units.zh: 天子以語丞相弘。
units.en: The Son of Heaven spoke of it to Chancellor Hong.
units.literal: Son of Heaven with spoke Chancellor Hong.

units.zh: 弘曰：「此非人情。
units.en: Hong said: “This is not human feeling.
units.literal: Hong said: “This is not human feeling.

units.zh: 不軌之臣，不可以為化而亂法，願陛下勿許。」
units.en: Such lawless subjects cannot be held up as models without undermining the law. I beg Your Majesty not to permit it.”
units.literal: Such lawless subjects cannot be held up as models without subverting the law. I beg Your Majesty not to permit it.”

units.zh: 於是上久不報式，數歲，乃罷式。
units.en: The emperor therefore gave Shi no reply for a long time, and after several years he let the matter drop.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor long gave no reply to Shi; after several years he set the matter aside.

units.zh: 式歸，復田牧。
units.en: Shi returned and again farmed and pastured.
units.literal: Shi returned, again farmed pastured.

units.zh: 歲餘，會軍數出，渾邪王等降，縣官費眾，倉府空。
units.en: More than a year later, with the army frequently in the field and the Hunye king and others having surrendered, government expenses mounted and the granaries and treasuries were empty.
units.literal: Year more, met army frequently went out, Hun Ye king etc. surrendered, county officials expenses many, granaries treasuries empty.

units.zh: 其明年，貧民大徙，皆仰給縣官，無以盡贍。
units.en: The next year, large numbers of poor people migrated. They all depended on the government for support, but there was no way to provide fully for them.
units.literal: Its next year, poor people greatly moved, all looked up supplied county officials, no with completely support.

units.zh: 卜式持錢二十萬予河南守，以給徙民。
units.en: Bu Shi brought 200,000 cash and gave it to the Governor of Henan to supply the relocated people.
units.literal: Bu Shi held money twenty ten thousand gave He Nan governor, to supply moved people.

units.zh: 河南上富人助貧人者籍，天子見卜式名，識之，曰「是固前而欲輸其家半助邊」，乃賜式外繇四百人。
units.en: Henan submitted a register of wealthy men who had aided the poor. When the Son of Heaven saw Bu Shi's name, he recognized him and said, “This is the man who earlier wished to contribute half his property to aid the frontier,” and granted Shi the commutation payments for four hundred men's frontier service.
units.literal: Henan submitted a register of wealthy men who had aided the poor. The Son of Heaven saw Bu Shi's name, recognized him, and said, “This is the man who earlier wished to contribute half his property to aid the frontier,” then granted Shi the commutation payments for four hundred men's frontier service.

units.zh: 式又盡復予縣官。
units.en: Shi then gave the county officials additional funds in full.
units.literal: Shi moreover completely again gave county officials.

units.zh: 是時富豪皆爭匿財，唯式尤欲輸之助費。
units.en: At this time, the rich and powerful all competed to conceal their wealth, but Bu Shi alone was eager to send his wealth in to help meet state expenses.
units.literal: At this time, the rich and powerful all competed to hide their wealth, but Bu Shi alone was eager to send his wealth in to help meet state expenses.

units.zh: 天子於是以式終長者，故尊顯以風百姓。
units.en: The Son of Heaven therefore considered Shi as a worthy elder, and therefore honored and displayed him to influence the hundred surnames.
units.literal: Son of Heaven therefore with Shi as worthy elder, therefore honored displayed to influence hundred surnames.

units.zh: 初，式不願為郎。
units.en: Initially, Shi did not wish to be a lang.
units.literal: Initially, Shi not wished be lang.

units.zh: 上曰：「吾有羊上林中，欲令子牧之。」
units.en: The emperor said, “I have sheep in Shanglin Park, and I want you, sir, to herd them.”
units.literal: The emperor said: “I have sheep in Shanglin Park and wish you, sir, to herd them.”

units.zh: 式乃拜為郎，布衣屩而牧羊。
units.en: Shi was then appointed as lang, and wearing cloth clothes and sandals, he pastured sheep.
units.literal: Shi then appointed lang, cloth clothes sandals and pastured sheep.

units.zh: 歲餘，羊肥息。
units.en: More than a year later, the sheep became fat and increased.
units.literal: Year more, sheep fat increased.

units.zh: 上過見其羊，善之。
units.en: The emperor passed by and saw his sheep, and approved of them.
units.literal: Emperor passed saw his sheep, good them.

units.zh: 式曰：「非獨羊也，治民亦猶是也。
units.en: Shi said, “This applies not only to sheep; governing the people is also like this.
units.literal: Shi said: “It is not only sheep; governing the people is also like this.

units.zh: 以時起居；
units.en: Rise and reside according to the time.
units.literal: By time rise reside;

units.zh: 惡者輒斥去，毋令敗群。」
units.en: Drive out the bad ones at once, and do not let them ruin the flock.”
units.literal: Drive out the bad at once and do not let them ruin the flock.”

units.zh: 上以式為奇，拜為緱氏令試之，緱氏便之。
units.en: The emperor considered Shi remarkable and, to test him, appointed him magistrate of Goushi, whose people found his administration beneficial.
units.literal: The emperor considered Shi remarkable and appointed him magistrate of Goushi to test him; the people of Goushi found his administration beneficial.

units.zh: 遷為成皋令，將漕最。
units.en: He was transferred to serve as magistrate of Chenggao, where his supervision of grain transport received the highest rating.
units.literal: He was transferred to serve as magistrate of Chenggao, where his supervision of grain transport received the highest rating.

units.zh: 上以為式樸忠，拜為齊王太傅。
units.en: The emperor considered Shi simple and loyal, and appointed him as grand tutor to the king of Qi.
units.literal: Emperor considered Shi simple loyal, appointed Qi king grand tutor.

units.zh: 而孔僅之使天下鑄作器，三年中拜為大農，列於九卿。
units.en: Kong Jin directed the empire's casting and manufacture of tools, and within three years he was appointed Great Farmer, ranking among the Nine Ministers.
units.literal: And Kong Jin made world cast make tools, three years middle appointed great farmer, ranked among nine ministers.

units.zh: 而桑弘羊為大農丞，筦諸會計事，稍稍置均輸以通貨物矣。
units.en: Sang Hongyang became Assistant to the Great Farmer, took charge of accounting affairs, and gradually established the equal-transport system to circulate goods.
units.literal: And Sang Hong Yang became great farmer assistant, managed various accounting affairs, gradually established equal transport to circulate goods.

units.zh: 始令吏得入穀補官，郎至六百石。
units.en: They began allowing clerks to contribute grain in exchange for office, with palace gentlemen receiving posts up to six hundred shi.
units.literal: Began ordered clerks could enter grain supplement offices, lang to six hundred shi.

units.zh: 自造白金五銖錢後五歲，赦吏民之坐盜鑄金錢死者數十萬人。
units.en: Five years after creating white gold and five-zhu coins, he pardoned the officials and commoners, numbering in the tens of thousands, who had been sentenced to death for illicitly casting gold coins.
units.literal: From made white gold five zhu money after five years, pardoned clerks people sat stole cast gold money died ones several ten thousand people.

units.zh: 其不發覺相殺者，不可勝計。
units.en: Those who killed one another without being discovered were beyond counting.
units.literal: Their not discovered mutually killed ones, could not be completely counted.

units.zh: 赦自出者百餘萬人。
units.en: More than a million people came forward voluntarily and were pardoned.
units.literal: Pardoned self came out ones hundred more ten thousand people.

units.zh: 然不能半自出，天下大抵無慮皆鑄金錢矣。
units.en: Yet not even half came forward voluntarily, and people throughout the empire generally went on casting gold coins without concern.
units.literal: Yet could not half self came out, world generally without worry all cast gold money.

units.zh: 犯者眾，吏不能盡誅取，於是遣博士褚大、徐偃等分曹循行郡國，舉兼并之徒守相為（吏）［利］者。
units.en: There were so many violators that the officials could not punish and confiscate from them all. The court therefore sent the erudites Chu Da, Xu Yan, and others in separate groups to inspect the commanderies and kingdoms and expose those who enriched themselves as governors or ministers by joining with powerful annexers.
units.literal: Violators many, clerks could not completely execute take, therefore sent erudites Chu Da, Xu Yan etc. divided sections followed toured commanderies kingdoms, raised annexed merged followers governors ministers for (clerks) [benefit] ones.

units.zh: 而御史大夫張湯方隆貴用事，減宣、杜周等為中丞，義縱、尹齊、王溫舒等用慘急刻深為九卿，而直指夏蘭之屬始出矣。
units.en: At this time, Imperial Censor Zhang Tang was rising in power and controlling affairs. Jian Xuan, Du Zhou, and others were appointed assistant censors; Yi Zong, Yin Qi, Wang Wenshu, and others used cruel, urgent, harsh, and searching methods as ministers among the Nine Ministers. Officials such as the Direct Commissioner Xia Lan began to appear.
units.literal: At this time, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Tang was at the height of his influence. Jian Xuan, Du Zhou, and others became assistant censors; Yi Zong, Yin Qi, Wang Wenshu, and others rose to the Nine Ministers through cruel, harsh, and exacting methods; and special commissioners such as Xia Lan began to be sent out.

units.zh: 而大農顏異誅。
units.en: The Grand Minister of Agriculture Yan Yi was executed.
units.literal: And great farmer Yan Yi executed.

units.zh: 初，異為濟南亭長，以廉直稍遷至九卿。
units.en: Initially, Yi was a pavilion chief in Jinan, and with integrity and straightness, he gradually moved to the nine ministers.
units.literal: Initially, Yi was Ji Nan pavilion chief, with integrity straight gradually moved to nine ministers.

units.zh: 上與張湯既造白鹿皮幣，問異。
units.en: The emperor, with Zhang Tang, having made white deer skin currency, asked Yi.
units.literal: Emperor with Zhang Tang having made white deer skin currency, asked Yi.

units.zh: 異曰：「今王侯朝賀以蒼璧，直數千，而其皮薦反四十萬，本末不相稱。」
units.en: Yi said: 'Now kings and marquises offer morning congratulations with blue jade bi, worth several thousand, but the skin presented instead is worth four hundred thousand. The root and tip do not match.'
units.literal: Yi said: 'Now kings marquises morning congratulations with blue jade bi, worth several thousand, but its skin presented instead forty ten thousand, root tip not match.'

units.zh: 天子不說。
units.en: The Son of Heaven was not pleased.
units.literal: Son of Heaven not pleased.

units.zh: 張湯又與異有卻，及有人告異以它議，事下張湯治異。
units.en: Zhang Tang also had a grudge against Yi. When someone accused Yi over other remarks, the matter was sent down to Zhang Tang to handle.
units.literal: Zhang Tang moreover with Yi had grudge, and someone accused Yi with other discussions, matter sent down Zhang Tang governed Yi.

units.zh: 異與客語，客語初令下有不便者，異不應，微反脣。
units.en: Yi spoke with a guest, and the guest spoke of the initial command that had been issued and had inconvenient aspects. Yi did not respond, but slightly turned his lips.
units.literal: Yi with guest spoke, guest spoke initial command issued had inconvenient ones, Yi not responded, slightly turned lips.

units.zh: 湯奏當異九卿見令不便，不入言而腹誹，論死。
units.en: Tang memorialized that Yi, as one of the nine ministers, saw the command as inconvenient, did not enter and speak, but slandered in his abdomen, and sentenced him to death.
units.literal: Tang memorialed should Yi nine ministers saw command inconvenient, not entered spoke but abdomen slandered, sentenced death.

units.zh: 自是之後，有腹誹之法（以此）［比］，而公卿大夫多諂諛取容矣。
units.en: After this, the law against inner slander was extended by analogy, and many high ministers and officials gained favor through flattery.
units.literal: After this, the law against inner slander was applied by analogy, and many high ministers and officials won favor through flattery.

units.zh: 天子既下緡錢令而尊卜式，百姓終莫分財佐縣官，於是（楊可）告緡錢縱矣。
units.en: After the Son of Heaven issued the cash-registration order and honored Bu Shi, the common people still did not contribute their wealth to assist the government. Yang Ke was then allowed to proceed with reports on concealed cash holdings.
units.literal: Son of Heaven having issued string money command and honored Bu Shi, hundred surnames finally none divided wealth assisted county officials, therefore (Yang Ke) accused string money let go.

units.zh: 郡國多姦鑄錢，錢多輕，而公卿請令京師鑄鐘官赤側，一當五，賦官用非赤側不得行。
units.en: The commanderies and kingdoms had many evil cast coins, and the coins were many and light. The dukes and ministers requested to order the capital to cast bell official red-side coins, one worth five, and the levy officials used them, but those not red-side could not proceed.
units.literal: Commanderies kingdoms many evil cast money, money many light, and dukes ministers requested ordered capital cast bell official red side, one when five, levy officials used not red side could not proceed.

units.zh: 白金稍賤，民不寶用，縣官以令禁之，無益。
units.en: White gold gradually cheapened, and the people did not treasure or use it. The county officials prohibited it with commands, but it was of no benefit.
units.literal: White gold gradually cheapened, people not treasured used, county officials with commands prohibited it, no benefit.

units.zh: 歲餘，白金終廢不行。
units.en: More than a year later, white gold was finally abolished and did not proceed.
units.literal: Year more, white gold finally abolished not proceeded.

units.zh: 是歲也，張湯死而民不思。
units.en: That year, Zhang Tang died, and the people did not think of him.
units.literal: This year also, Zhang Tang died and people not thought of.

units.zh: 其後二歲，赤側錢賤，民巧法用之，不便，又廢。
units.en: Two years afterward, red-side coins cheapened, and the people used skillful laws with them. It was inconvenient, and they were again abolished.
units.literal: Its after two years, red side money cheapened, people skillful laws used it, inconvenient, again abolished.

units.zh: 於是悉禁郡國無鑄錢，專令上林三官鑄。
units.en: Therefore, they all prohibited the commanderies and kingdoms from casting money, and specially ordered the three officials of Shanglin to cast.
units.literal: Therefore, all prohibited commanderies kingdoms no cast money, specially ordered Shang Lin three officials cast.

units.zh: 錢既多，而令天下非三官錢不得行，諸郡國所前鑄錢皆廢銷之，輸其銅三官。
units.en: Once the coinage had become plentiful, an order was issued that no coins could circulate unless they came from the Three Offices. The coins previously cast by the commanderies and kingdoms were all abolished and melted down, and their copper was transported to the Three Offices.
units.literal: Money already many, and ordered world not three officials money could not proceed, various commanderies kingdoms previously cast money all abolished melted it, transported their copper three officials.

units.zh: 而民之鑄錢益少，計其費不能相當，唯真工大姦乃盜為之。
units.en: Private coin-casting by the people became increasingly rare, since the costs no longer balanced out. Only expert craftsmen and major criminals still did it illicitly.
units.literal: And people's cast money moreover few, calculated its expenses could not match, only true craftsmen great evil ones then stole did it.

units.zh: 卜式相齊，而楊可告緡遍天下，中家以上大抵皆遇告。
units.en: Bu Shi became chancellor of Qi, and Yang Ke's reports on concealed cash holdings spread throughout the empire. Families of middling means and above were almost all accused.
units.literal: Bu Shi chancellor Qi, and Yang Ke accused string money spread world, middle families above generally all encountered accusation.

units.zh: 杜周治之，獄少反者。
units.en: Du Zhou handled the cases, and few convictions were overturned.
units.literal: Du Zhou governed it, prisons few reversed ones.

units.zh: 乃分遣御史廷尉正監分曹往，即治郡國緡錢，得民財物以億計，奴婢以千萬數，田大縣數百頃，小縣百餘頃，宅亦如之。
units.en: They then dispatched imperial secretaries, assistant commandants of justice, and inspectors in separate sections to investigate registered cash holdings in the commanderies and kingdoms on the spot. They seized people's wealth and goods in the hundreds of millions, slaves in the tens of thousands, fields amounting to several hundred qing in large counties and more than a hundred qing in small ones, and houses in similar numbers.
units.literal: Then divided sent imperial secretaries court judge assistants supervisors divided sections went, immediately governed commanderies kingdoms string money, got people's wealth goods counted in hundred million, slave women counted in thousand ten thousand, fields big counties several hundred qing, small counties hundred more qing, houses also like it.

units.zh: 於是商賈中家以上大率破，民偷甘食好衣，不事畜藏之產業，而縣官有鹽鐵緡錢之故，用益饒矣。
units.en: Thus, merchants and families of middling means and above were largely ruined. People furtively consumed fine food and wore good clothing, no longer investing in stored wealth or productive property. But because the government had salt, iron, and cash-registration revenues, its resources became increasingly abundant.
units.literal: Therefore, merchants middle families above greatly generally broken, people secretly sweet ate good clothes, not managed stored hidden industries, but county officials had salt iron string money reason, use moreover abundant.

units.zh: 益廣關，置左右輔。
units.en: They also expanded the passes and established left and right assistants.
units.literal: Moreover, broadened pass, established left right assistants.

units.zh: 初，大農筦鹽鐵官布多，置水衡，欲以主鹽鐵；
units.en: Initially, the Great Farmer managed the salt and iron officials, whose numbers had grown large. The Water Balance was established with the intention of taking charge of salt and iron;
units.literal: Initially, great farmer managed salt iron officials spread many, established water balance, wanted to master salt iron;

units.zh: 及楊可告緡錢，上林財物眾，乃令水衡主上林。
units.en: When Yang Ke's reports on concealed cash holdings brought large quantities of wealth and goods into Shanglin, they ordered the Water Balance to take charge of Shanglin.
units.literal: And Yang Ke accused string money, Shang Lin wealth goods many, then ordered water balance master Shang Lin.

units.zh: 上林既充滿，益廣。
units.en: Once Shanglin was full, they expanded it further.
units.literal: Shang Lin already filled full, moreover broadened.

units.zh: 是時越欲與漢用船戰逐，乃大修昆明池，列觀環之。
units.en: At this time, Yue wanted to use boats with Han to battle and pursue, so they greatly repaired the Kunming Pool and arranged towers to surround it.
units.literal: This time Yue wanted with Han used boats battled pursued, then greatly repaired Kunming Pool, arranged towers surrounded it.

units.zh: 治樓船，高十餘丈，旗幟加其上，甚壯。
units.en: They made tower boats, more than ten zhang high, with the flags and banners added on them, and they were very strong.
units.literal: Made tower boats, high ten more zhang, flags banners added on it, very strong.

units.zh: 於是天子感之，乃作柏梁臺，高數十丈。
units.en: Therefore, the Son of Heaven sensed it, and then made the Boliang Terrace, several tens of zhang high.
units.literal: Therefore, Son of Heaven sensed it, then made Bo Liang Terrace, high several ten zhang.

units.zh: 宮室之修，由此日麗。
units.en: The repair of palace rooms, from this time, became daily more beautiful.
units.literal: Palace rooms repair, from this daily beautiful.

units.zh: 乃分緡錢諸官，而水衡、少府、大農、太仆各置農官，往往即郡縣比沒入田田之。
units.en: They then distributed the cash-registration revenues among the offices, and the Water Balance, Lesser Treasury, Great Farmer, and Grand Coachman each established agricultural officials, who often went to nearby commanderies and counties to farm confiscated fields.
units.literal: Then divided string money various officials, and water balance, Shao Fu, great farmer, Tai Pu each established farm officials, often took commanderies counties nearby confiscated fields farmed them.

units.zh: 其沒入奴婢，分諸苑養狗馬禽獸，及與諸官。
units.en: The confiscated slaves were divided among the imperial parks to raise dogs, horses, birds, and beasts, and were also assigned to government offices.
units.literal: Their confiscated slave women, divided various gardens raised dogs horses birds beasts, and gave various officials.

units.zh: 諸官益雜置多，徒奴婢眾，而下河漕度四百萬石，及官自糴乃足。
units.en: The offices became increasingly numerous and overlapping, and convict laborers, male and female, multiplied. Grain transported down the Yellow River amounted to four million shi, and with official purchases added, supplies were sufficient.
units.literal: Various officials moreover mixed established many, convict slave women many, but lower Yellow River transported crossed four hundred ten thousand shi, and officials self bought then sufficient.

units.zh: 所忠言：「世家子弟富人或鬬雞走狗馬，弋獵博戲，亂齊民。」
units.en: Suo Zhong said, “Sons of eminent houses and the wealthy sometimes fight cocks, race dogs and horses, hunt and shoot, gamble and play, thereby disordering the common people.”
units.literal: Suo Zhong said: “Sons of eminent houses and the wealthy sometimes fight cocks, run dogs and horses, hunt and shoot, gamble and play—disordering the common people.”

units.zh: 乃徵諸犯令，相引數千人，命曰「株送徒」。
units.en: They then summoned those who had violated the edict. Mutual denunciations implicated several thousand people, who were called “convicts sent off in chains.”
units.literal: Then they summoned those who violated the edict; mutual denunciations implicated several thousand people, whom they named “convicts sent off in chains.”

units.zh: 入財者得補郎，郎選衰矣。
units.en: Those who entered wealth got to supplement lang, and lang selections declined.
units.literal: Entered wealth ones got supplemented lang, lang selections declined.

units.zh: 是時山東被河菑，及歲不登數年，人或相食，方一二千里。
units.en: At this time, Shandong suffered a Yellow River disaster, and for several years the harvests were not abundant. The people sometimes ate each other, in an area of one to two thousand li.
units.literal: This time Shan Dong suffered Yellow River disaster, and years not abundant several years, people or mutually ate, area one two thousand li.

units.zh: 天子憐之，詔曰：「江南火耕水耨，令饑民得流就食江淮閒，欲留，留處。」
units.en: The Son of Heaven pitied them and issued an edict: “In Jiangnan they burn fields and weed by water. Let the hungry people move to seek food between the Jiang and Huai; those who wish to remain may remain where they are.”
units.literal: The Son of Heaven pitied them and issued an edict: “In Jiangnan they burn off fields and weed by water; let the hungry people move to seek food between the Jiang and Huai; those who wish to stay may remain there.”

units.zh: 遣使冠蓋相屬於道，護之，下巴蜀粟以振之。
units.en: They sent messengers in a continuous stream along the roads to protect them, and sent grain down from Bashu to relieve them.
units.literal: Sent messengers official hats continuously connected on road, protected them, sent down Ba Shu grain to relieve them.

units.zh: 其明年，天子始巡郡國。
units.en: The next year, the Son of Heaven began to tour the commanderies and kingdoms.
units.literal: Its next year, Son of Heaven began toured commanderies kingdoms.

units.zh: 東度河，河東守不意行至，不辨，自殺。
units.en: Going east, they crossed the Yellow River, and the governor of Hedong did not expect the travel to arrive and was not prepared, so he committed suicide.
units.literal: East crossed Yellow River, He Dong governor not expected travel arrived, not prepared, committed suicide.

units.zh: 行西踰隴，隴西守以行往卒，天子從官不得食，隴西守自殺。
units.en: Traveling west, the imperial party crossed Long. The governor of Longxi was caught unprepared by the tour's sudden arrival; the Son of Heaven's attendants had no food, and the governor committed suicide.
units.literal: Traveling west, the imperial party crossed Long. The governor of Longxi was caught unprepared by the tour's sudden arrival; the Son of Heaven's attendants had no food, and the governor committed suicide.

units.zh: 於是上北出蕭關，從數萬騎，獵新秦中，以勒邊兵而歸。
units.en: Therefore, the emperor went north and exited Xiaoguan, followed by several tens of thousands of cavalry, hunted in the new Qin middle, and restrained the border troops and returned.
units.literal: Therefore, emperor north exited Xiao Guan, followed several ten thousand cavalry, hunted new Qin middle, to restrain border troops and return.

units.zh: 新秦中或千里無亭徼，於是誅北地太守以下，而令民得畜牧邊縣，官假馬母，三歲而歸，及息什一，以除告緡，用充仞新秦中。
units.en: In the New Qin region, there were stretches of a thousand li without watch stations. Therefore, the Grand Administrator of Beidi and his subordinates were executed, and the people were ordered to raise livestock in the border counties. The officials lent out breeding mares; after three years the borrowers returned them with one-tenth of the increase. This replaced the concealed-cash reporting system and was used to fill and populate the New Qin region.
units.literal: New Qin middle or thousand li no watch stations, therefore executed Bei Di grand administrator below, and ordered people could raise livestock border counties, officials lent mare mothers, three years and return, and increased one tenth, to remove accuse string money, used fill populate new Qin middle.

units.zh: 既得寶鼎，立后土、太一祠，公卿議封禪事，而天下郡國皆豫治道橋，繕故宮，及當馳道縣，縣治官儲，設供具，而望以待幸。
units.en: After obtaining the precious ding, they established sacrifices to Houtu and Taiyi. The dukes and ministers discussed the feng and shan sacrifices, and the commanderies and kingdoms throughout the realm all prepared by repairing roads and bridges and restoring former palaces. Counties along the imperial roads managed official stores, prepared supplies, and waited expectantly for an imperial visit.
units.literal: Having got precious ding, established Hou Tu, Tai Yi sacrifices, dukes ministers discussed feng shan affairs, and world commanderies kingdoms all prepared repaired roads bridges, mended former palaces, and should gallop road counties, counties administered official stores, set up supplies, and gazed to await favor.

units.zh: 其明年，南越反，西羌侵邊為桀。
units.en: The next year, Nanyue rebelled, and the Xiqiang invaded the border and became rebellious.
units.literal: Its next year, Nan Yue rebelled, Xi Qiang invaded border became rebellious.

units.zh: 於是天子為山東不贍，赦天下［囚］，因南方樓船卒二十餘萬人擊南越，數萬人發三河以西騎擊西羌，又數萬人度河筑令居。
units.en: Therefore, because resources east of the mountains were insufficient, the Son of Heaven pardoned prisoners throughout the realm. More than two hundred thousand tower-ship troops from the south were used to attack Nanyue. Several tens of thousands of cavalry were sent west of Sanhe to attack the Xiqiang, and several tens of thousands more crossed the Yellow River and built Lingju.
units.literal: Therefore, Son of Heaven for Shan Dong not sufficient, pardoned world [prisoners], using south tower boat troops twenty more ten thousand attacked Nan Yue, several ten thousand sent San He west cavalry attacked Xi Qiang, moreover several ten thousand crossed Yellow River built Ling Ju.

units.zh: 初置張掖、酒泉郡，而上郡、朔方、西河、河西開田官，斥塞卒六十萬人戍田之。
units.en: They first established the commanderies of Zhangye and Jiuquan, and in Shangjun, Shuofang, Xihe, and Hexi they opened agricultural offices. They expanded the frontier garrisons, and six hundred thousand soldiers guarded and farmed the land.
units.literal: Initially established Zhang Ye, Jiu Quan commanderies, and Shang Jun, Shuo Fang, Xi He, He Xi opened field officials, expanded border troops sixty ten thousand garrisoned farmed them.

units.zh: 中國繕道餽糧，遠者三千，近者千餘里，皆仰給大農。
units.en: The central states repaired roads and transported grain. The farthest routes were three thousand li and the nearest more than a thousand li, and all supplies came from the Grand Minister of Agriculture.
units.literal: Central states repaired roads sent grain, far ones three thousand, near ones thousand more li, all looked up supplied great farmer.

units.zh: 邊兵不足，乃發武庫工官兵器以贍之。
units.en: The frontier troops lacked equipment, so weapons from the imperial armory and workshops were issued to supply them.
units.literal: Border troops insufficient, then issued martial storehouse craftsmen official weapons to support them.

units.zh: 車騎馬乏絕，縣官錢少，買馬難得，乃著令，令封君以下至三百石以上吏，以差出牝馬天下亭，亭有畜牸馬，歲課息。
units.en: Horses for chariots and cavalry were exhausted, government funds were low, and horses were hard to buy. A decree was therefore issued ordering everyone from enfeoffed lords down to officials of three hundred shi and above to contribute mares according to rank to the post stations throughout the empire. The stations raised the mares and assessed their yearly increase.
units.literal: Chariot cavalry horses lacked exhausted, county officials money few, buy horses difficult got, then established command, ordered sealed lords below to three hundred shi above clerks, by differences sent out female horses world pavilions, pavilions had raised female horses, yearly assessed interest.

units.zh: 齊相卜式上書曰：「臣聞主憂臣辱。
units.en: The chancellor of Qi, Bu Shi, submitted a memorial saying: 'I, your minister, have heard that when the lord worries, the minister is shamed.
units.literal: Qi chancellor Bu Shi memorialed said: 'Minister heard lord worries minister shames.

units.zh: 南越反，臣願父子與齊習船者往死之。」
units.en: Nanyue has rebelled, and I, your minister, ask that my son and I, together with those in Qi skilled with boats, go and die in the campaign.'
units.literal: Nan Yue rebelled, minister wishes father son with Qi practiced boat ones go die for it.'

units.zh: 天子下詔曰：「卜式雖躬耕牧，不以為利，有餘輒助縣官之用。
units.en: The Son of Heaven issued an edict saying: 'Bu Shi personally farms and herds, yet does not pursue profit; whenever he has a surplus, he assists government expenses.
units.literal: Son of Heaven issued edict said: 'Bu Shi although personally farmed pastured, not took as profit, had surplus then assisted county officials use.

units.zh: 今天下不幸有急，而式奮願父子死之，雖未戰，可謂義形於內。
units.en: Now the world has unfortunately met an emergency, and Shi has roused himself and asked that he and his son die in the campaign. Although they have not yet fought, this may be called righteousness taking form within.
units.literal: Now world unfortunately has urgency, and Shi aroused wished father son die for it, although not yet battled, can be called righteousness shaped within.

units.zh: 賜爵關內侯，金六十斤，田十頃。」
units.en: I grant him the nobility of Guannei Hou, sixty jin of gold, and ten qing of fields.'
units.literal: Granted nobility Guan Nei Hou, gold sixty jin, fields ten qing.'

units.zh: 布告天下，天下莫應。
units.en: The proclamation went out to the realm, but no one responded.
units.literal: It was proclaimed to the realm, but none in the realm responded.

units.zh: 列侯以百數，皆莫求從軍擊羌、越。
