units.en: The ranked marquises numbered in the hundreds, yet none asked to accompany the army in attacking the Qiang and Yue.
units.literal: Arranged marquises by hundred counted, all none sought follow army attack Qiang, Yue.

units.zh: 至酎，少府省金，而列侯坐酎金失侯者百餘人。
units.en: At the libation ceremony, the Shaofu inspected the gold, and more than a hundred ranked marquises were convicted over their libation gold and stripped of their marquisates.
units.literal: At the libation ceremony, the Shaofu inspected the gold, and more than a hundred ranked marquises were convicted over their libation gold and lost their marquisates.

units.zh: 乃拜式為御史大夫。
units.en: Then they appointed Shi as Imperial Censor.
units.literal: Then appointed Shi as Imperial Censor.

units.zh: 式既在位，見郡國多不便縣官作鹽鐵，鐵器苦惡，賈貴，或彊令民賣買之。
units.en: Once Shi was in office, he saw that many commanderies and kingdoms found government salt and iron production inconvenient. The iron tools were poor, prices were high, and in some places the people were forced to buy and sell them.
units.literal: Shi already in position, saw commanderies kingdoms many inconvenient county officials made salt iron, iron tools bitter bad, merchants expensive, or strongly ordered people bought sold them.

units.zh: 而船有算，商者少，物貴，乃因孔僅言船算事。
units.en: Because boats were taxed, merchants were few and goods were expensive. Through Kong Jin, he reported on the boat tax.
units.literal: And boats had tax, merchants few, goods expensive, then through Kong Jin spoke boat tax affairs.

units.zh: 上由是不悅卜式。
units.en: The emperor therefore was not pleased with Bu Shi.
units.literal: Emperor therefore not pleased Bu Shi.

units.zh: 漢連兵三歲，誅羌，滅南越，番禺以西至蜀南者置初郡十七，且以其故俗治，毋賦稅。
units.en: Han kept troops in the field for three years, punished the Qiang, and extinguished Nanyue. From Panyu westward to the south of Shu, it established seventeen new commanderies, governed them according to local customs, and imposed no taxes.
units.literal: Han connected troops three years, executed Qiang, extinguished Nan Yue, Pan Yu west to Shu south ones established initial commanderies seventeen, moreover with their former customs governed, no taxes.

units.zh: 南陽、漢中以往郡，各以地比給初郡吏卒奉食幣物，傳車馬被具。
units.en: The commanderies beyond Nanyang and Hanzhong, each according to its land resources, supplied the clerks and troops of the new commanderies with provisions, food, money, goods, relay carriages, horses, and transport equipment.
units.literal: Nan Yang, Han Zhong past commanderies, each with land proportion supplied initial commanderies clerks troops provisions food currency goods, relay carriages horses covered equipment.

units.zh: 而初郡時時小反，殺吏，漢發南方吏卒往誅之，閒歲萬餘人，費皆仰給大農。
units.en: The new commanderies sometimes had minor rebellions in which officials were killed. Han sent southern officials and troops to punish them, with more than ten thousand people mobilized every other year. All the expenses were supplied by the Grand Minister of Agriculture.
units.literal: And initial commanderies sometimes small rebelled, killed clerks, Han sent southern clerks troops went executed them, between years ten thousand more people, expenses all looked up supplied great farmer.

units.zh: 大農以均輸調鹽鐵助賦，故能贍之。
units.en: Through equal transport and control of salt and iron, the Great Farmer supplemented tax revenues and could therefore support these expenses.
units.literal: Great farmer with equal transport regulated salt iron assisted taxes, therefore could support them.

units.zh: 然兵所過縣，為以訾給毋乏而已，不敢言擅賦法矣。
units.en: Yet the counties through which the troops passed merely drew on their own resources to prevent shortages, and no one dared call this unauthorized taxation.
units.literal: Yet the counties through which the troops passed drew on their own resources to prevent shortages, and no one dared call this unauthorized taxation.

units.zh: 其明年，元封元年，卜式貶秩為太子太傅。
units.en: The next year, in the first year of Yuanfeng, Bu Shi was demoted in rank and became grand tutor to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: Its next year, Yuan Feng first year, Bu Shi demoted rank became Crown Prince grand tutor.

units.zh: 而桑弘羊為治粟都尉，領大農，盡代僅筦天下鹽鐵。
units.en: Sang Hongyang became Colonel for the Management of Grain, took charge of the Great Farmer's office, and took over from Kong Jin in managing the empire's salt and iron.
units.literal: And Sang Hong Yang became Governing Grain colonel, led great farmer, completely replaced Jin managed world salt iron.

units.zh: 弘羊以諸官各自市，相與爭，物故騰躍，而天下賦輸或不償其僦費，乃請置大農部丞數十人，分部主郡國，各往往縣置均輸鹽鐵官，令遠方各以其物貴時商賈所轉販者為賦，而相灌輸。
units.en: Hongyang observed that because officials each bought goods on their own and competed with one another, prices rose sharply, and the empire's taxes and transport levies sometimes did not cover their hired expenses. He therefore requested the establishment of several dozen divisional assistants under the Great Farmer, assigned by region to oversee the commanderies and kingdoms. Equal transport, salt, and iron offices were commonly established in the counties. Distant regions were ordered, when their local goods were expensive, to use what merchants transported and sold as tax payments, so that the regions could supply one another.
units.literal: Hongyang observed that because the various offices each made their own purchases, they competed with one another and drove prices sharply upward, while taxes shipped from across the empire sometimes did not cover their freight costs. He therefore requested the appointment of several dozen regional assistants to the Grand Farmer, each responsible for a group of commanderies and kingdoms. Equal-transport and salt-and-iron offices were established in selected counties, and distant regions were ordered to pay their taxes in local goods of the kinds merchants normally transported for sale when prices were high, so that goods could be transferred and supplied among the regions.

units.zh: 置平準于京師，都受天下委輸。
units.en: They established the Equalization Office at the capital, where transported goods from throughout the empire were received.
units.literal: Established level standard at capital, capital received world entrusted transports.

units.zh: 召工官治車諸器，皆仰給大農。
units.en: They summoned artisan officials to repair carriages and equipment, all supplied by the Grand Minister of Agriculture.
units.literal: Summoned craftsmen officials repaired carriages various tools, all looked up supplied great farmer.

units.zh: 大農之諸官盡籠天下之貨物，貴即賣之，賤則買之。
units.en: The Great Farmer's officials brought the empire's goods under their control, selling when prices were high and buying when prices were low.
units.literal: Great farmer various officials completely contained world goods, expensive then sold them, cheap then bought them.

units.zh: 如此，富商大賈無所牟大利，則反本，而萬物不得騰踴。
units.en: In this way, rich merchants and great traders had no way to pursue enormous profits, so they returned to basic occupations, and prices no longer surged wildly.
units.literal: Like this, rich merchants great traders nowhere sought great profits, then returned to fundamentals, and myriad things not got to leap jump.

units.zh: 故抑天下物，名曰「平準」。
units.en: Therefore, they stabilized prices throughout the realm, and the policy was named “Equalization.”
units.literal: Therefore, they stabilized goods throughout the realm, and the policy was named “Equalization.”

units.zh: 天子以為然，許之。
units.en: The Son of Heaven considered it so and permitted it.
units.literal: Son of Heaven considered it so, permitted it.

units.zh: 於是天子北至朔方，東到太山，巡海上，并北邊以歸。
units.en: The Son of Heaven then went north to Shuofang and east to Taishan, toured the coast, and returned along the northern frontier.
units.literal: Therefore, Son of Heaven north to Shuo Fang, east to Tai Shan, toured sea above, along north border to return.

units.zh: 所過賞賜，用帛百餘萬匹，錢金以巨萬計，皆取足大農。
units.en: Wherever he passed, he distributed rewards and gifts, spending more than a million bolts of silk and money and gold counted in the tens of thousands. All of it was drawn from the Great Farmer.
units.literal: Passed places rewarded bestowed, used silk hundred more ten thousand bolts, money gold counted in huge ten thousands, all took sufficient great farmer.

units.zh: 弘羊又請令吏得入粟補官，及罪人贖罪。
units.en: Hongyang also requested an order allowing clerks to contribute grain in exchange for office and allowing criminals to redeem their crimes.
units.literal: Hong Yang moreover requested ordered clerks could enter grain supplement offices, and criminals redeem crimes.

units.zh: 令民能入粟甘泉各有差，以復終身，不告緡。
units.en: An order was issued allowing people to contribute grain at Ganquan in graded amounts in exchange for lifelong exemption from service and from reports under the string-cash tax.
units.literal: Ordered people could enter grain Gan Quan each had differences, to exempt lifetime, not accuse string money.

units.zh: 他郡各輸急處，而諸農各致粟，山東漕益歲六百萬石。
units.en: Other commanderies each transported supplies to places of urgent need, and the agricultural officials each delivered grain. Shipments from Shandong increased by six million shi per year.
units.literal: Other commanderies each transported urgent places, and various farmers each brought grain, Shan Dong transported moreover year six hundred ten thousand shi.

units.zh: 一歲之中，太倉、甘泉倉滿。
units.en: Within one year, the great granary and Ganquan granary were full.
units.literal: One year middle, great granary, Gan Quan granary full.

units.zh: 邊餘穀諸物均輸帛五百萬匹。
units.en: Surplus grain and other goods from the frontier were moved through the equal-transport system, and the silk amounted to five million bolts.
units.literal: Border surplus grain various goods equal transported silk five hundred ten thousand bolts.

units.zh: 民不益賦而天下用饒。
units.en: The people's taxes were not increased, yet the resources available to the empire were abundant.
units.literal: People not increased taxes and world use abundant.

units.zh: 於是弘羊賜爵左庶長，黃金再百斤焉。
units.en: Sang Hongyang was then granted the rank of Left Chief of the Multitude and two hundred jin of gold.
units.literal: Thereupon Sang Hongyang was granted the rank of Left Chief of the Multitude and two hundred jin of gold.

units.zh: 是歲小旱，上令官求雨，卜式言曰：「縣官當食租衣稅而已，今弘羊令吏坐市列肆，販物求利。
units.en: That year there was a slight drought, and the emperor ordered officials to pray for rain. Bu Shi said, “Officials should live on rents and dress themselves from taxes alone; now Sang Hongyang has made them sit in the market and sell goods.
units.literal: That year there was a slight drought; the emperor ordered officials to pray for rain. Bu Shi said: “The officials should live on rents and dress on taxes alone; now Sang Hongyang has clerks sit in market rows and shops, peddling goods for profit.

units.zh: 亨弘羊，天乃雨。」
units.en: Execute Sang Hongyang, and Heaven will send rain.”
units.literal: Execute Sang Hongyang, and heaven will then rain.”

units.zh: 太史公曰：農工商交易之路通，而龜貝金錢刀布之幣興焉。
units.en: The Grand Historian said: When the roads of exchange for farming, commerce, and artisans were connected, the currencies of turtle shells, cowries, gold, money, knives, and cloth arose.
units.literal: Grand Historian said: farming commerce artisans exchange roads connected, and turtle shells cowries gold money knives cloth currencies arose there.

units.zh: 所從來久遠，自高辛氏之前尚矣，靡得而記云。
units.en: Its origins lay in the remote past, even before the age of Gaoxin, and cannot be recorded.
units.literal: Its origins lay in remote antiquity, even before the age of Gaoxin, and could not be recorded.

units.zh: 故書道唐虞之際，詩述殷周之世，安寧則長庠序，先本絀末，以禮義防于利；
units.en: Therefore, the writings spoke of the time of Tang and Yu, and the poems described the age of Yin and Zhou. When peaceful, they grew schools, put fundamentals first and reduced ends, and with rites and righteousness guarded against profits;
units.literal: Therefore, writings spoke Tang Yu time, poems described Yin Zhou age, peaceful then grew schools, first fundamentals reduced ends, with rites righteousness guarded against profits;

units.zh: 事變多故而亦反是。
units.en: When affairs changed and had many troubles, they also reversed this.
units.literal: Affairs changed many troubles and also reversed this.

units.zh: 是以物盛則衰，時極而轉，一質一文，終始之變也。
units.en: Therefore, when things flourish, they then decline. When time reaches an extreme, it then turns. One solid, one pattern—this is the change of beginning and end.
units.literal: Therefore, things flourish then decline, time extreme then turn, one solid one pattern, beginning end change also.

units.zh: 禹貢九州，各因其土地所宜，人民所多少而納職焉。
units.en: In Yu's tribute system, the nine provinces paid their levies according to what their lands produced and the size of their populations.
units.literal: Yu tribute nine provinces, each according to their land suitable, people more less and paid duties there.

units.zh: 湯武承獘易變，使民不倦，各兢兢所以為治，而稍陵遲衰微。
units.en: Tang and Wu inherited worn-out systems and changed them with ease, so that the people were not exhausted. Each governed with anxious care, yet over time their houses gradually declined and weakened.
units.literal: Tang Wu inherited exhaustion easily changed, made people not weary, each earnestly so governed, but gradually declined weakened.

units.zh: 齊桓公用管仲之謀，通輕重之權，徼山海之業，以朝諸侯，用區區之齊顯成霸名。
units.en: Duke Huan of Qi used Guan Zhong's strategy, mastered the balance of light and heavy, controlled the industries of mountains and seas, and brought the feudal lords to court. With the small state of Qi, he made his name as hegemon shine.
units.literal: Qi Huan duke used Guan Zhong strategy, connected light heavy power, cornered mountain sea industries, to make audience feudal lords, used small small Qi displayed became hegemon name.

units.zh: 魏用李克，盡地力，為彊君。
units.en: Wei employed Li Ke, fully developed the productive capacity of its land, and became powerful.
units.literal: Wei employed Li Ke, fully developed the productive capacity of its land, and became powerful.

units.zh: 自是以後，天下爭於戰國，貴詐力而賤仁義，先富有而後推讓。
units.en: From this time on, the world contended through the Warring States, valuing deceit and force while slighting benevolence and righteousness; wealth came first, and deference came afterward.
units.literal: From this after, world contended in Warring States, valued deceit force but cheapened benevolence righteousness, first rich had then afterward yielded.

units.zh: 故庶人之富者或累巨萬，而貧者或不厭糟糠；
units.en: Therefore, some wealthy commoners accumulated fortunes of many tens of thousands, while some poor people could not even fill themselves with bran and husks;
units.literal: Therefore, commoners rich ones or accumulated huge ten thousand, but poor ones or not satisfied with bran husks;

units.zh: 有國彊者或并群小以臣諸侯，而弱國或絕祀而滅世。
units.en: Some powerful states annexed clusters of smaller ones and reduced other lords to submission, while weak states saw their sacrifices cut off and their lines extinguished.
units.literal: Had states strong ones or annexed groups small to serve feudal lords, but weak states or cut sacrifices extinguished generations.

units.zh: 以至於秦，卒并海內。
units.en: This continued down to Qin, which finally united all within the seas.
units.literal: To arrived at Qin, finally united within seas.

units.zh: 虞夏之幣，金為三品，或黃，或白，或赤；
units.en: In the currencies of Yu and Xia, gold was of three kinds: either yellow, or white, or red;
units.literal: Yu Xia currencies, gold as three kinds, or yellow, or white, or red;

units.zh: 或錢，或布，或刀，或龜貝。
units.en: or coins, or cloth, or knives, or turtle shells and cowries.
units.literal: Or coins, or cloth, or knives, or turtle shells cowries.

units.zh: 及至秦，中一國之幣為（三）［二］等，黃金以溢名，為上幣；
units.en: By the time of Qin, the currency of the unified state was divided into two grades: yellow gold, measured by the yi, served as the higher currency;
units.literal: And to Qin, unifying one state currencies as (three) [two] grades, yellow gold with yi named, as upper currency;

units.zh: 銅錢識曰半兩，重如其文，為下幣。
units.en: copper coins bore the inscription 'half liang', weighed what the inscription stated, and served as the lower currency.
units.literal: Copper coins inscription said half liang, heavy like its writing, as lower currency.

units.zh: 而珠玉、龜貝、銀錫之屬為器飾寶藏，不為幣。
units.en: Pearls, jade, turtle shells, cowries, silver, tin, and the like were used for vessels, ornaments, and stored treasure, but not as currency.
units.literal: And pearls jade, turtle shells cowries, silver tin kind as vessel decorations treasure stores, not as currency.

units.zh: 然各隨時而輕重無常。
units.en: Yet each changed with the times, and their relative value was never fixed.
units.literal: Yet each followed time and light heavy no constant.

units.zh: 於是外攘夷狄，內興功業，海內之士力耕不足糧馕，女子紡績不足衣服。
units.en: Abroad they drove back the Yi and Di, while at home they undertook great works. Men throughout the realm farmed with all their strength yet had too little grain to eat, and women spun and wove yet had too little clothing to wear.
units.literal: Thus, abroad they repelled the Yi and Di, and at home they launched great undertakings; yet the men of the realm could not produce enough provisions however hard they farmed, nor could its women weave enough cloth for clothing.

units.zh: 古者嘗竭天下之資財以奉其上，猶自以為不足也。
units.en: People of old could exhaust the resources and wealth of the world to support those above them and still think it insufficient.
units.literal: Ancient ones often exhausted world resources wealth to support their superiors, still self considered insufficient also.

units.zh: 無異故云，事勢之流，相激使然，曷足怪焉。
units.en: There is no special reason for this. The momentum of affairs, each force driving the next, made it so. Why should it be surprising?
units.literal: No different therefore speak, affairs situations flow, mutually stimulated made so, why sufficient strange there.
